summary: Returns the local machine IP address as a dotted-decimal string. Initializes an in_addr via htonl(0) (INADDR_ANY), copies a 16-byte network context from this+673 into a local buffer, converts the address with inet_ntoa, then copies the result into an output buffer through sub_587DD0 with a size limit of a3-1 and appends a null terminator. Returns 1 on success, 0 if inet_ntoa fails.

local_names.v4: result of inet_ntoa (dotted-decimal string or NULL)
local_names.v6: local 16-byte copy of network address context

Call sub_587DD0(a2, v4, a3 - 1) to copy the IP string into the output buffer with a copy limit of a3-1 bytes.
Write a null terminator at the last output buffer position: *(a3 - 1 + a2) = 0.
